title: Quality Setup: every setup has a way back
audience: Developers who need repository-local quality setup without silent mutation or irreversible installation.
promise: Inspect the ecosystem, preview the owned change, apply explicitly, verify the result, refuse conflicts, and recover through a rollback receipt.
story: A clean Node repository is recognized as a supported pnpm target.
The plan names one repository-local config and a reversible change.
Explicit apply writes only the owned config and rollback receipt.
Verification passes, a second plan refuses overwrite, and rollback removes only the owned config.
verified_locally: Current dev branch is clean at f153fff78575d17eb90fc37174ac4edbe02d73e1; repository tests, lint, and package checks pass.
Supported Node/pnpm inspection and clean-target detection.
Preview-first plan with an explicit reversible file change.
Apply, verify, conflict refusal, and rollback on an isolated fixture.
A crop-safe 1600x900 SVG/PNG preview is visually inspected.
open_gates: The product currently verifies node --version after apply; a real quality-command smoke remains open.
Add a second supported ecosystem or document the narrow Node boundary.
Record external GitHub, portfolio, and Handshake readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves current dev checks and one local W1 Node/pnpm setup workflow on an isolated fixture; it does not claim a real quality-command smoke, installation into a user's repository, broad ecosystem support, hosting, or publication.
